kpis.label: Azure Policy compliance
kpis.formula: Compliant / (Compliant + NonCompliant) policy evaluations. Exempt, Unknown and not-started evaluations are excluded and shown separately.

kpis.label: Non-compliant resources
kpis.formula: Distinct resources with at least one NonCompliant evaluation / distinct resources with any evaluation.

kpis.label: Fully compliant resources
kpis.formula: Resources with no NonCompliant evaluation / resources with at least one Compliant or NonCompliant evaluation.

kpis.label: High-impact failing policies
kpis.formula: Distinct failing policy definitions whose own metadata severity is High or Critical. Not available when no collected definition carries severity metadata.

kpis.label: Enforcement-class failing policies
kpis.formula: Distinct failing policy definitions with effect deny, deployIfNotExists, modify or append.

kpis.label: Machines baseline check pass rate
kpis.formula: Passed checks / all checks in Fresh Machine Configuration reports (Azure Windows baseline). 0 reports excluded as not fresh.

kpis.label: Machine baseline coverage
kpis.formula: Eligible machines with a fresh report / eligible machines. 1 assigned, 1 with a usable report.

kpis.label: Exemptions expiring in 30 days
kpis.formula: Active exemptions whose expiry is within the next 30 days / all exemptions.

kpis.label: Evidence freshness
kpis.formula: Evaluations newer than 24 h / all evaluations.

labels: Azure Policy compliance %, check pass rate and coverage are separate metrics and are never combined.
Results describe Azure Policy / Machine Configuration reports; they are not a CIS, ISO, NIS2 or DORA certification or attestation.
No data is not compliance: missing or stale evidence is never green.
Azure Policy compliance % = Compliant / (Compliant + NonCompliant) policy evaluations; Exempt and Unknown evaluations are shown apart and never counted as compliant.
There is no composite risk score. Every figure shows its own numerator, denominator and grain.
Groups with nothing to count show 'no data', never 100 %.
